t: The Best Wi-Fi Extender and Signal Booster of 2026 | Reviews by Wirecutter
s: August 26, 2025 - If you absolutely need Wi-Fi 7: The TP-Link RE655BE/RE653BE has Wi-Fi 7 compatibility and was able to extend a strong Wi-Fi 7 signal to our test laptop in a room that had zero 6 GHz Wi-Fi 7 coverage from the TP-Link Archer GE800 router. We were able to achieve speeds of 700 Mbps or higher using either 5 GHz or 6 GHz Wi-Fi 7 in our test bathroom. The RE655BE and RE653BE are functionally identical, differing only in where you can buy them; we think you should choose whichever is cheaper at the time.
